issue.title: Eliminate the intermittent concurrent bead-mutation lock timeout
issue.description: Proposed by sase-dd.7 after full-suite verification. The regression test test_concurrent_bead_mutations_wait_past_the_old_lock_timeout intermittently reproduces a ValueError after waiting 5000 ms for the exclusive bead-store lock, even with the explicit-size test setup added later by sase-dr.2. Reproduce under contention, determine whether the implementation or test deadline is wrong, and make the concurrency contract deterministic without hiding genuine lock starvation. The latest land audit reproduced one failed worker while all Artifacts Beads integration tests passed.
